links.title: Google says it fixed more Chrome bugs in June than over the past two years, thanks to AI | TechCrunch
links.description: As experts have warned for the last two years, some companies — like Microsoft and now Google — are finding and patching an exponential number of bugs in their products, thanks to the use of LLMs and AI tools.
